verses.zh: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。
verses.en: Genealogical records were kept for all Israel; they are recorded in the Scroll of the Kings of Israel.The people of Judah[NOTE:1] were carried away to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
notes: The Hebrew text has simply “Judah,” though the verb הָגְלוּ (hoglu, “carried away”) is plural.

verses.zh: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁的首领。
verses.en: The first to resettle on their property and in their cities were some Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and the inhabitants, the first who [were] in their property in their cities, Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.”

verses.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人、便雅悯人、以法莲人、玛拿西人。
verses.en: Some from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.[NOTE:1]
notes: For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.

verses.zh: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子；亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子；音利是巴尼的儿子。
verses.en: The settlers included:[NOTE:1] Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, who was a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
notes: The words “the settlers included” are supplied in the translation for clarity and for stylistic reasons.

verses.zh: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。
verses.en: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

verses.zh: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
verses.en: From the descendants of Zerah: Jeuel. Their relatives numbered 690.

verses.zh: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路，
verses.en: From the descendants of Benjamin:Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;

verses.zh: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，
verses.en: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.

verses.zh: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱计算共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。
verses.en: Their relatives, listed in their genealogical records, numbered 956. All these men were leaders of their families.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and all these men were heads of fathers for the house of their fathers.”

verses.zh: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
verses.en: From the priests:Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;

verses.zh: 还有管理　神殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
verses.en: Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub the leader in God’s temple;

verses.zh: 有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子；雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是米实利密的儿子；米实利密是音麦的儿子。
verses.en: Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.

verses.zh: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于做　神殿使用之工的。
verses.en: Their relatives, who were leaders of their families, numbered 1,760. They were capable men who were assigned to carry out the various tasks of service in God’s temple.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “capable [for] the work of the task of the house of God.”

verses.zh: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅。
verses.en: From the Levites:Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah a descendant of Merari;

verses.zh: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅，
verses.en: Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mika, son of Zikri, son of Asaph;

verses.zh: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。
verses.en: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived among the settlements of the Netophathites.

verses.zh: 守门的是沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔，和他们的弟兄；沙龙为长。
verses.en: The gatekeepers were:Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers. Shallum was the leader;

verses.zh: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。
verses.en: he serves to this day at the King’s Gate on the east. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the descendants of Levi.

verses.zh: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。
verses.en: Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his relatives from his family (the Korahites) were assigned to guard the entrance to the sanctuary.[NOTE:1] Their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the Lord’s dwelling place.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “and his brothers belonging to the house of his father, the Korachites, to the work of the task, guardians of the threshold of the tent.”

Heb “and their fathers to the camp of the Lord, guardians of the entrance.” Here “fathers” is used in a more general sense of “forefathers” or “ancestors” and is not limited specifically to their fathers only.

verses.zh: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。
verses.en: Phinehas son of Eleazar had been their leader in earlier times, and the Lord was with him.

verses.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。
verses.en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the guard at the entrance to the meeting tent.

verses.zh: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。
verses.en: All those selected to be gatekeepers at the entrances numbered 212. Their names were recorded in the genealogical records of their settlements. David and Samuel the prophet[NOTE:1] had appointed them to their positions.[NOTE:2]
notes: The Hebrew term is רֹאֶה (roʾeh, “seer”), an older word for נָבִיא (naviʾ, “prophet”).
Heb “they—David appointed, and Samuel the seer, in their position.”

verses.zh: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。
verses.en: They and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the Lord’s sanctuary (that is, the tabernacle).[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and they and their sons to the gates of the house of the Lord, of the house of the tent, [were assigned] as guards.”

verses.zh: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。
verses.en: The gatekeepers were posted on all four sides—east, west, north, and south.

verses.zh: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。
verses.en: Their relatives, who lived in their settlements, came from time to time and served with them for seven-day periods.

verses.zh: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守　神殿的仓库。
verses.en: The four head gatekeepers, who were Levites, were assigned to guard the storerooms and treasuries in God’s sanctuary.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “in the house of God.”

verses.zh: 他们住在　神殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。
verses.en: They would spend the night in their posts all around God’s sanctuary,[NOTE:1] for they were assigned to guard it and would open it with the key every morning.
notes: Heb “in the house of God.”

verses.zh: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入；
verses.en: Some of them were in charge of the articles used by those who served; they counted them when they brought them in and when they brought them out.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and from them over the articles of the task, for by number they would bring them in, and by number they would bring them out.”

verses.zh: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。
verses.en: Some of them were in charge of the equipment and articles of the sanctuary,[NOTE:1] as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices.
notes: Heb “holy place.”

verses.zh: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
verses.en: (But some of the priests mixed the spices.)

verses.zh: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。
verses.en: Mattithiah, a Levite, the firstborn son[NOTE:1] of Shallum the Korahite, was in charge of baking the bread for offerings.
notes: The word “son” is not in the Hebrew text, but is implied.

verses.zh: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。
verses.en: Some of the Kohathites, their relatives, were in charge of preparing the bread that is displayed each Sabbath.

verses.zh: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在属殿的房屋，昼夜供职，不做别样的工。
verses.en: The musicians and Levite family leaders stayed in rooms at the sanctuary[NOTE:1] and were exempt from other duties, for day and night they had to carry out their assigned tasks.
notes: Heb “were in rooms.” The words “at the sanctuary” are supplied in the translation for clarification.

verses.zh: 以上都是利未人着名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。
verses.en: These were the family leaders of the Levites, as listed in their genealogical records. They lived in Jerusalem.

verses.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；
verses.en: Jeiel (the father of Gibeon) lived in Gibeon. His wife[NOTE:1] was Maacah.
notes: Heb “The name of his wife.”

verses.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
verses.en: His firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.zh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。
verses.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。
verses.en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They also lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “and also they, opposite their brothers, lived in Jerusalem with their brothers.” This redundancy has been removed in the translation.map For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.

verses.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施・巴力。
verses.en: Ner was the father of Kish, and Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.[NOTE:1]
notes: Eshbaal is called “Ishbosheth” in 2 Sam 2:8.

verses.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力・巴力（就是米非波设）；米力・巴力生米迦。
verses.en: The son of Jonathan:Meribbaal,[NOTE:1] who was the father of Micah.
notes: Meribbaal is called “Mephibosheth” in 2 Sam 4:4.

verses.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯。
verses.en: The sons of Micah:Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.[NOTE:1]
notes: The name “Ahaz” is included in the Vulgate and Syriac, but omitted in the MT. It probably was accidentally omitted by haplography. Note that the name appears at the beginning of the next verse. Cf. also 8:35.

verses.zh: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；
verses.en: Ahaz was the father of Jarah,[NOTE:1] and Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza,
notes: So MT; some Hebrew mss and the LXX read “Jadah” (cf. NIV, NCV, NLT) while in 8:36 the name “Jehoaddah’ appears (cf. NAB).

verses.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚生利法雅；利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
verses.en: and Moza was the father of Binea. His son was Rephaiah, whose son was Eleasah, whose son was Azel.

verses.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。
verses.en: Azel had six sons: Azrikam his firstborn,[NOTE:1] followed by Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
notes: The Hebrew text has בֹּכְרוּ (bokheru), which some understand as a name: “Bocheru” (so, e.g., NEB, NASB, NIV, NRSV, NLT). But the form should probably be revocalized בְֹּכרוֹ (bekhoro, “his firstborn”). A name has accidentally dropped from the list, and a scribe apparently read בֹּכְרוּ as one of the names. Cf. also 1 Chr 8:38.
